notes: Data-driven encounter catalogue. patches/ube_patch.csx generates the in-game catalogue from this file at build time. Battlegroup numbers were read from scr_battlegroup in the installed Undertale v1.08 data.win. status/enabled/displayName are filled in from the automated sweep by scripts/apply-sweep.ps1: verified = fought to a victory and returned to the menu; starts = battle starts and runs but its ending is unverified; needs-adapter = left the battle for a story room, crashed or ended the game.
omitted: Battlegroups not listed: 1 (debug test monsters), 19 (empty), 21 (duplicate Loox), 69-75 (Mettaton bomb-defusal sub-battles), 87-90 (Lost Souls, part of the Asriel fight). Photoshop Flowey does not use room_battle.

adapters.generic_battlegroup: Reset state with SCR_GAMESTART, apply the player configuration, set global.battlegroup and global.currentroom, then room_goto(room_battle).
